195503.overview:
In 2013, the Masters of the Universe pinball table was originally created by a developer known as ROM for the Future Pinball platform. 

This 2013 version served as the foundation for significant subsequent community updates, most notably the Collector's Edition (2024) by TerryRed.

196226.overview:
Miss World is a rare pinball conversion kit released in December 1982 by the German manufacturer Geiger-Automatenbau. It is known for featuring hand-drawn nudity on the playfield and backglass. 

It was designed as a conversion kit for the Bally "Kiss" pinball machine and only 150 kits were produced. The artwork was created by Michele "Mike" Martinelli.

While primarily sold as a kit to be installed in existing Bally cabinets, it was also available as a "Komplett-Flipper" (complete machine) directly from Geiger.

208974.overview: Avengers: Age of Ultron is one of the three Marvel pinball tables available in the Cinematic Pack for Pinball FX 3, originally released as a standalone table for Pinball FX 2 and Zen Pinball 2 shortly before the film's release. The table depicts the events of the 2015 MCU film of the same name, following the Avengers' efforts to stop a rogue AI originally created by Tony Stark to defend the world.

208977.overview: Ant-Man is one of the three Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Cinematic Pack, released in 2015 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the 2015 Marvel Cinematic Universe film Ant-Man, directed by Peyton Reed, this pinball table explores the efforts of scientist Hank Pym to recruit the crook Scott Lang to become the superhero Ant-Man and use his size-altering powers to stage a daring heist of the Yellowjacket, a weaponized, shrinking suit produced by Darren Cross' abuse of Pym's shrinking technology.

208989.overview: Civil War (or Marvel: Civil War) is one of the three Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Heavy Hitters pack in Pinball FX 3, originally released in 2012 for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX 2 as a standalone table. The table is based on the 2006-2007 crossover comic book of the same title, in which the high collateral damage from a battle between superheroes and supervillains sparks calls for government control of superheroes. This carries divisive moral implications, resulting in infighting among superheroes disagreeing over whether it should be implemented.

208993.overview: Moon Knight is one of the four Marvel pinball tables released as part of the Vengeance and Virtue pack, and is the fourth and final table in that pack to be released in late 2011, available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. It is based on the nocturnal superhero Moon Knight, who gains superpowers from the Egyptian god Khonshu after being betrayed and murdered and seeks vengeance upon various adversaries.

460274.overview: Meteor, released around 1981 by Taito do Brasil, is a 4-player solid-state digital pinball machine manufactured in São Paulo, Brazil. It is a version of Stern's 1979 'Meteor' manufactured under license from Stern, as indicated on the playfield apron. According to a pinball club in Brazil, Meteor is the only game from Taito do Brasil that acknowledges licensing.

460277.overview:
Mr. & Mrs. Pec-Men is a pinball machine from 1983, manufactured by LTD do Brasil.

This pinball has 3 flippers, 11 drop targets, 6 standup targets, 2 pop bumpers, 2 sling shots, 2 saucers, and a 5x5 matrix of lights in the playfield called the Pec-Maze.

The main objective when playing Mr. & Mrs. Pec-Men pinball is to collect ‘moves’ then complete as many Pec-Mazes as you can. Progress in the current maze is scored at the end of each ball. Completed mazes are scored again at the end of the game.

Mr. & Mrs. Pec-Men pinball has one of the hardest opening skill-shots. It requires just the right amount of plunger force to allow the ball to drop into the saucer. The reward is immediate entry into the Pec-Maze with 10 additional moves and Aggressive mode (where you can chase the red ghost instead of running from it).

Entering the saucers will either progress toward an extra ball or enter the Pec-Maze if the minimum moves have been collected. Each Pec-Maze must be completed in a set amount of time. Chasing too many ghosts in Aggressive move will use up your time quickly. Once you run out of time, you may not re-enter the Pec-Maze until the next ball.

The 6-digit display in the playfield keeps track of your Pac-Maze progress. The right-most two digits let you know how many moves you have been awarded. The middle two digits keeps track of the number of Pec-Mazes completed. The left-most displays tracks the number of seconds you have left to complete the current maze. The five pecmen lights below the 6-digit display indicate the number of 'lives' left for which the ghost (red light) in the maze can hit you when not in Aggressive mode.

460287.overview:
Mr. Black, produced by Taito do Brasil in 1984, is a solid-state pinball machine with a fantasy theme. The playfield layout closely mirrors that of Williams' 1982 'Defender,' featuring three flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, multiple drop targets, a standup target, and a captive ball walker.

Mr. Black came from the depths of the world to rule the Earth: your misson is to try to destroy him. Shoot down the "guardians of evil" who are blinking. By completing one side, one of Mr Black's lives will be destroyed. Defeat Mr Black by destroying his 8 lives, and win an extra game.

Hit the upper target to release the balls trapped in the "bat cave" After releasing 2 or 3 balls from the cave, hit the upper target to win an extra game. The "bat cave" lock balls independently for each player.

Increase the energy multiplier by turning off the four lights of the  "labyrinth of terror".

462163.overview: Metropolis (1981) is a rare electromechanical-style machine with digital scoring produced by the Spanish manufacturer Maresa. The artwork is inspired by the futuristic, industrial themes of the classic 1927 science fiction film by Fritz Lang.

467984.overview: Splosion Man captured! The World is safe... At least, that's what they thought! Straight from the science lab, Ms. Splosion Man is out of control, even more dangerous...and pinker than her better half. She's on a mission to save Splosion Man from the grasp of the giant robot, the Mighty Eternal. The Scientists will try anything to stop her during this perilous quest. Ms. Splosion Man will Splode herself through Energy Walls, Electric Beam Hazards, Rollerbots, and hundreds of barrels and Zip lines to reach her goal and save Splosion Man.

468508.overview: Champions is one of the two Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Women of Power pack, released in the fall of 2016 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. It is based on the female members of the 2016 superhero team known as the Champions, and follows an original story in which Ms. Marvel, leader of the Champions, must defeat the Bombshells and save the world while thwarting their theft of her first day of work's paycheck.

468512.overview:
Mars is one of the early Zen Pinball original tables, first released in Zen Pinball for the PlayStation 3, and is also part of the 3-table Sci-Fi pack. It is inspired by future visions of human expeditions to and exploration of the planet Mars, and involves completing missions to navigate its rough terrain and unveiling its mysteries with advanced technology and vehicles in the year 2100.

Even though Mars and Earth Defense involve interaction with aliens, the events of Mars do not precede that of Earth Defense because the events of the latter's plotline predate that of Mars. Thus, Earth Defense is not a sequel to Mars.

468522.overview:
My Little Pony is one of the Animated Heroes tables released first for Zen Pinball Party on Apple Arcade (September 3, 2021), and later for Pinball FX (February 16, 2023). The table retells select events from the 2010 animated series, My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, with an easier ruleset than many Zen tables to introduce a younger audience to pinball.

The primary goal of this table is to play through all five Mane Missions, each corresponding to one of the ponies, and then start the wizard mode. Mane Missions are started by shooting one of five major lanes up to three times; on the first playthrough, each shot only needs to be made once to start a mission, increasing by one for subsequent playthroughs to a maximum of three shots required.

During each main mission, all shots will score 250,000 points, with the right scoop scoring "great shots" worth 500,000 points and other features listed below scoring additional points as well. Once the fifth mission has been played, the wizard mode will be lit at the right scoop; missions can be replayed at any time during single-ball play, and only the first playthrough of each mission will count towards lighting the wizard mode. Each Mane Mission lasts 30 seconds - the timer pauses while a ball is in the bumpers or about to be plunged.

If the sixth ball is locked for Elements of Harmony Multiball while a Mane Mission is active, the Mane Mission will instantly end.

468536.overview:
The Avengers is one of the four Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Avengers Chronicles Pack, released in 2012 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the blockbuster film The Avengers, this table involves uniting various Marvel superheroes under the leadership of SHIELD director Nick Fury to confront Loki and thwart his scheme to rule the world with an alien army.

Months after this table was released, Stern produced a physical pinball adaptation of the film with different designs, mechanics and behaviors than Zen's The Avengers table.

468557.overview:
Guardians of the Galaxy is one of the three Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Cinematic Pack, released in 2014 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the 2014 Marvel Cinematic Universe film of the same name, directed by James Gunn and featuring characters from the 2008 incarnation of the Guardians of the Galaxy, this pinball table focuses on the Guardians of the Galaxy, a band of former galactic criminals, and their mission to stop the Kree extremist Ronan.

A few years after this table was released, Stern produced a physical pinball adaptation of the film.

468588.overview: A-Force is one of the two Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Women of Power pack, released in the fall of 2016 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. Based on the 2015 comic book series of the same title, this table covers an original story in which Black Widow and Madame Masque accidentally end up in a different reality where the Soviet Union takes over the United States after a fight that destroys the Cosmic Cube. The two unlikely partners must put aside their differences to restore reality.

469288.overview:
One small flip for man... Explore Lunar landscapes and zero-gravity gameplay in this out-of-this-world mission.

Moon Flight, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in October 1976, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a space exploration theme. Known for its stunning artwork and fast gameplay, it is considered one of the better EM games from that era. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and nine standup targets, offering players a variety of shot opportunities. 

Sources estimate production numbers at roughly 2,390 units for the single-player version and 1,190 units for a four-player version.

470301.overview: A homebrew digital table for Visual Pinball based around Mojang Studios' 2011 sandbox game.

470427.overview:
A darker, more mysterious castle! Enhanced magic, sharper effects, and even spookier surprises await.

Magic Castle 2017 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1984 solid state Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2017 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470566.overview: Based on Stern's 2001 physical pinball table "Monopoly", this is an enhanced homebrew version for Visual Pinball X with original graphics based on World of Warcraft characters.

470586.overview:
Mario Kart, let's-a-go!

Go for first as you blast off with DK, take a ride on rainbow road (don’t fall off!), spin your way through Wario Stadium, get bounced around Waluigi Pinball, and fill up at Coconut Mall in Mario Kart Pinball!

Mario Kart Pinball is a mod of Gottlieb's 1995 racing table, "Mario Andretti".

470802.overview:
Wake up, Neo.

Welcome to The Matrix Pinball, by Pincredibles. Prepare for a pinball adventure like no other.

You are stationed aboard The Nebuchadnezzar aided by Tank, your operator. Tank will help you as you guide the crew; Neo, Trinity, Niobe and Morpheus as they try to free the minds of the human race and free them from the imprisonment of the Matrix.

It won’t be smooth sailing. Agent Smith, Brown and Jones will attempt to stop you at all costs. Cypher is sneaking about, waiting to betray Morpheus and the crew. Sentinels will attack the ship and the Zion outpost.

Visiting the Oracle could bring you some answers and perks to help. Do not forget to go through the training programs to gain perks and increase your Matrix mode score.

Good luck. Maybe Morpheus was right. Maybe you are The One.

471084.overview:
Metal Slug is a community-created original table, primarily developed for Future Pinball (with a version also appearing in Visual Pinball X) that translates the frenetic, run-and-gun action of the SNK arcade classic into a pinball format. Known for its intense, fast-paced gameplay, the table is a polished example of custom virtual pinball design. 

The table heavily features art, characters, and soundbites from the Metal Slug series, including recognizable elements like the tanks (Metal Slugs), soldiers, and hostages. True to the arcade game, the table often involves completing specific modes or "missions" to progress. The layout is designed for high-energy play, featuring cannons that act as toys, multiple ramp shots, drop targets, and a third flipper on the right.

471566.overview: An original table for Visual Pinball X by Marty02 based on the famous Tom Cruise movie franchise.

472027.overview:
Viva la diversión! Celebrate with pulsing combos, explosive multiball, and vibrant festival energy as you chase the Fest Bonus and unlock Carnival Mode. The party starts with every flick!

This table is a modernized version of the original Mexico table from 1986 and celebrates the vibrant culture and traditions of Mexico. From lively festivals to colorful skulls and candles, Mexico Deluxe brings a fresh visual upgrade and deeper gameplay to a nostalgic favorite. 

Light up the night with Mexico Mode, unleash Multiball, and chase high scores through exciting features like Combo, Kickback, and Multiplier. The table includes six unique modes—Yellow, Red, Spirit, Celebrate, Fiesta, and Festival—as well as three fun mini-games: Nut, Sombrero, and Way.

Whether you're aiming for the Fest Bonus or diving into Carnival Mode, Mexico Deluxe delivers nonstop pinball action with a bold cultural flair.

472393.overview: A mod for Visual Pinball X of Data East's King Kong table from 1990.

474197.overview:
Based on Capcom's long-running video game series, Megaman is an original table for Future Pinball by Brendan Bailey (aka Pinwizkid). Released in 2006, the table is widely celebrated for its elaborate integration of classic side-scrolling gaming mechanics into a 3D pinball environment. Players can choose to play as either Mega Man or Proto Man at the start of the game, which directly impacts the table's overall difficulty. True to the core franchise, players can target and fight various classic Mega Man villains (Robot Masters) before advancing to a final showdown against Dr. Wily. In 2023, FusionshadowXJ released an updated version for Future Pinball with modern physics, better lighting, and better audio.

Rules:

1. Character Select - At the start of each game, you will prompted to select a character (either Megaman or Protoman). The character you pick determines the game's difficulty.  If you pick Megaman, the game will be easier to beat because you can only lose lives when the ball is lost via the lower drain.  If you pick Protoman, you can lose lives in either the lower drain or the upper playfield drain, making it harder.  The game will show a different ending slideshow if and when you beat Dr. Wily for each character. 

2. Energy and Lives - In this pinball machine, you do not get a set number of balls to play. Instead, you have a certain number of lives and energy. You start with 3 lives, and can get an additional life at 1,000,000 points. In each life, you get 8 energy, which if lost, will result in the loss of a life. You can lose energy in a variety of ways, but you mainly lose it from letting the ball drain. If you are on level 1, you will lose 1 energy when the ball drains, on levels 2 to 4, you lose 2 energy, levels 5 & 6, you lose 3 energy, and on level 7, you lose 4 energy. When you have lost all 8 energy, the words "Low Energy" will appear for a moment, indicating that if you lose the ball one more time, you will lose a life.  You also lose energy if the ball drains from the upper deck.  If you are playing as Protoman, you will lose a life if the ball drains on the upper deck (if you have low energy).  The game is over when you lose all your lives. It is not uncommon for 1 game to last for a long time, and it is likely you will play more than 10 balls throughout the game. 

3. Defeating Enemies - The object of the game is to defeat Dr. Wily and 6 of his robots (Gutsman, Cutman, Iceman, Magnetman, Geminiman, and Bass). When you start the game (or after you defeat an enemy), "Stage Select" will be lit. When you shoot the ball from the plunger, or shoot the ball through either spinner, you will start the next level. The camera will focus on the backglass display for a moment to show you the next enemy. When play starts up again, the center 5 drop targets will sequence through a pattern of popping up and popping down, making them difficult to hit (Each enemy has a different pattern).

479816.overview:
Mandrake the Magician was a syndicated newspaper comic strip, created by Lee Falk in 1934. It is regarded by many comic historians as the first ever comic superhero.

This original electro-mechanical style table was released first for Future Pinball in 2013 by Daz, and an upgraded port for Visual Pinball X was released by Marty02 in 2026.

479942.overview:
Set in 1532, The Mysterious Cities of Gold follows Esteban, an 11-year-old orphan in Barcelona, Spain, who possesses a mysterious ability to summon the sun. Recruited by a navigator named Mendoza, Esteban joins an expedition to the New World to find his lost father and the fabled Seven Cities of Gold.

Originally screened in 1982–1983, and co-produced by French company DIC Entertainment and Japanese studio Pierrot, this animated historical fantasy adventure series serves as the theme for the Visual Pinball X table, "Les Mystérieuses Cités d'Or", a mod of Bally's 1979 table, Supersonic.

480159.overview: Mars Attacks for Visual Pinball 9 is a mod of Asteroid Annie and the Aliens (Gottlieb, 1980). It is based on the 1996 Tim Burton science fiction comedy movie about a martian invasian of the Earth.

480169.overview:
Mars Attacks Popeye is an original Future Pinball table released by Tii in 2014. It is based on the 2013 comic book crossover one-shot published by IDW Publishing as part of their company-wide Mars Attacks event. It was written by Martin Powell with art by Terry Beatty. 

Martian invaders from the Mars Attacks franchise—dubbed "Barsoomus Invaderus" by Professor Wotasnozzle—descend upon Sweethaven. The villainous Sea Hag teams up with the alien conquerors to take over the world. Popeye, along with allies like Alice the Goon, Pappy, Professor Wotasnozzle, and Eugene the Jeep, fight back using their classic grit, high-tech support, and plenty of spinach to defeat both the Martians and the Sea Hag.

480178.overview: Released for Visual Pinball X by Donuts, the table keeps the table layout, rom file, DMD and sounds from "Attack From Mars" (Bally/Midway, 1995), but gives a visual reskin based on the "Mars Attacks!" movie from 1996. An optional PuP pack was also released, providing video clips from the movie.

480181.overview:
Released for Future Pinball in 2006, Roney Pinball's "Mission Impossible" table is based on the Tom Cruise movie "Mission: Impossible III" which had hit cinemas earlier that year. In 2013, SLAMT1LT released his "VIP Edition" of Roney's game, making various tweaks whilst keeping the overall look the same. Changes included new music, different lighting, minor playfield changes, and different artwork on the apron and backpanel.

**ATTRACT MODE**

Press M to fire the gun in Attract Mode.  When finished playing with the gun, unload it by pressing the Insert Coin key twice.  Wait until the balls drain before starting a new game.

** OBJECTIVE **

The objective is to lite MISSION IMPOSSIBLE by completing various objectives around the table.  Lighting IMPOSSIBLE MISSION awards the 20 Million Super Jackpot.  

** IMF MISSIONS **

To start the IMF Mission you must first knock down the 2 yellow Mission Targets.  Then hit the red Hostile Target to light the feature.  Hit the Mission Kicker to start the mission. and then take down the IMF Target to complete the mission, which will lite one of the IMPOSSIBLE letters in the centre ring.  Complete all the missions and lite IMPOSSIBLE to win the 10 Million IMF Jackpot.

** MULTIBALL **

Load the gun with 3 balls and hit the Multi-Ball Kicker to start the Multi-Ball feature.  During this mode, all ramps score 100k and loading the gun scores 500k.

** BONUS **

Hit the top left kicker to advance the bonus.  When the bonus is full you can light the Jackpot, Extra Ball and Special lights but knocking down the 2 yellow ramp targets.  Hit the top left kicker again to collect these awards.

** BONUS HELD **

Lite the 5x Muliplier to hold the bonus when the ball is lost.  Nothing on the playfield will reset when a new ball comes into play, holding all bonuses and any progress you made.

** TIPS **

When the ball is first lauched and hits the Top Middle Kicker, Keep the Upper Left Flipper up to catch the ball when it's ejected from the kicker.  The will enable you to easily take down the 2 yellow Ramp Targets.

When hitting the Left or Middle Ramps remember to use the flippers to change the Out/In Lane lights when the ball is returned to the lower playfield.  Then you can easily lite the Muliplier lights and gain the Bonus Held.

*** CHEAT ***

Press R during the game to lower the Ramp Gate at any time.  Tom Cruise will utter: "Show me the money" to indicate the cheat has worked.

480182.overview: A Future Pinball version of Stern's best-selling Meteor table. Originally released in 1979, Meteor was an early solid-state game, so though it featured electronic sound, it didn't have any music. The ULTRA Edition by SLAMT1LT remedies this with well-chosen music to suit the fast-paced gameplay, and table theme.

480390.overview:
Use your pinball skills to help Thomas Magnum and team solve the mystery. Rev the engine, solve the case, and unleash the Aloha spirit - Magnum P.I. Pinball is on the case!

Magnum P.I.nBall is a mod of Quicksilver (Stern, 1980) for Visual Pinball X based on the American crime drama series that ran for eight seasons from 1980-1988, starring Tom Selleck as private investigator (P.I.) Thomas Magnum.

480434.overview:
Lock and load for a high impact pinball mission! Step into the boots of Colonel James Braddock and take on an explosive rescue mission in Missing in Action Pinball! Inspired by the legendary Chuck Norris film, this action-packed game delivers intense combat, daring escapes, and high-powered gameplay. Can you rescue the POWs and defeat the enemy? No man gets left behind!

Missing in Action for Visual Pinball X is a mod of the JP Salas table "El Bueno El Feo y el Malo".

480504.overview: Phenom's tribute to the best-selling female recording artist of all time is a mod of Odisea Paris-Dakar (Peyper, 1987) for Visual Pinball X.

480875.overview:
Summon the spirit of the arcade with a visually explosive, mechanically intense pinball game, themed after the iconic Mortal Kombat II video game. Every flip, multiball, and ramp brings you deeper into the realms of Outworld.

Mortal Kombat II: Pinball Edition was the first original table by Visual Pinball developer Javier1515, and it was released in 2016.
